parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to be pressed by the user to dispense liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that pushes down to create pressure in the pump mechanism, allowing liquid to be dispensed through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle and supports the pressing lid’s movement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent PET plastic, used to hold liquid soap or lotion.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the reservoir for the liquid.
